original_table_rows.environment_and_nearby_objects: Photo prints, pens, books, lamp, shelving and chair. This is a genuine seated printing activity—not a requirement for every printer scene.

original_table_rows.environment_and_nearby_objects: Laptop, documents and cup on neighboring workspace; office chairs and glass partitions. Printer has its own working area.

original_table_rows.alignment_and_support: Black printer on a light-colored desktop, with its front facing image-left and its side visible. The photograph does not rotate the printer front toward the camera.

original_table_rows.environment_and_nearby_objects: Chairs, monitor, telephone, plant and wall map. A printer need not sit directly in front of a chair.
